title: Booking-Fee Return for Time Overruns on Wayfare Rides
content:
**Return of the booking fee.** On a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, a booking-fee return follows how far the trip's actual minutes ran beyond its estimated minutes (the overrun is the actual minutes less the estimated minutes), together with the fare charge amount as booked. The booking fee in question is the booking fee of the trip's ride option.

- An overrun of at least the long overrun minutes, 20 minutes, on a fare charge of at least the booking-return fare floor of $40.00 returns the ride option's booking fee in full (1.0 times the booking fee).
- Otherwise, an overrun of at least the short overrun minutes, 10 minutes, returns the partial share of the booking fee: 0.6 times the booking fee.
- A shorter overrun returns nothing.

## Combinations

| Overrun (minutes) | Fare charge | Booking-fee return |
|---|---|---|
| 20 or more | $40.00 or more | the full booking fee |
| 20 or more | below $40.00 | 0.6 of the booking fee |
| at least 10, below 20 | any | 0.6 of the booking fee |
| below 10 | any | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; booking fee $3.10)

- Overrun 24 minutes, fare charge $46.10: full return, $3.10.
- Overrun 24 minutes, fare charge $38.00: below the $40.00 floor, so 0.6 of $3.10, that is $1.86.
- Overrun 10 minutes, fare charge $60.00: 0.6 of $3.10, $1.86.
- Overrun 9 minutes: nothing.
- A ride option whose booking fee is $0.00 returns $0.00 at every overrun.
